mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.2% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a severe contraction in both manufacturing and construction sectors, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 112 and HOUST < 1190, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high-demand regimes characterized by strong residential sales (RSAFS > 380,000 million dollars) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210), the real income squeeze from inflation erodes consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 380,000 and CPIAUCSL > 210, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential sales (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 in a 2-month window, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 110 over 2 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 210) leads to a real interest rate increase that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 210, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad weakening in the housing market, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1190 and RSAFS < 380000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.
